title: Halloween is special for me, here is the year 1 costume in my game
author: PuzzleheadedBlood184
selftext:
Hey everyone, as some of you know I am building my game in 3 months from scratch, on a $200 laptop, with no money and no friends 😂

Halloween is my favorite day of the year, so for the last 2 days I worked only on Halloween stuff. This is the first costume of the 4 years: the Plague Doctor 🎃 The video is a quick showcase from an in game cutscene.

The game loop runs on a 4 year calendar, so every year has a different costume:  
Year 1: Plague Doctor  
Year 2: Serial killer clown  
Year 3: Zombie  
Year 4: Pumpkinhead farmer

My laptop can’t run a screen recorder without crashing, so I filmed the screen with my phone again 🥲 Sorry for the quality.

I am gonna share the second clip in the replies below. What do you think about the Plague Doctor? Let me know your thoughts guys, or tell me what costumes you would add 🫶🏼
